items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: actually was a guy who played piano for us at Carnegie Hall with the Catatonic Five. But I took my horn over there and he was very nice to me.

ctx.x: Derry Hall. And Derry went to Hamilton and actually played with some of the jazz bands there and actually was a guy who played piano for us at Carnegie Hall with the Catatonic Five. But I took my horn over there and he was very nice to me. He’d just graduated that
year or a year before, and we played a little bit and then I met Emerson and the Catatonic Five came together and that’s how it all happened.
